facts.text: John mentions that his family, exercise, and spending time with friends are sources of inspiration.

evidence.quote: My family, exercise, and spending time with friends, for sure.
When times get hard, I look at it and remember why I'm doing what I'm doing. My family is my motivation and they keep me going.

facts.text: Maria states that finding special sources of inspiration is key for staying motivated and tackling challenges.

facts.text: John shares a photo from a walk last week that reminds him to take a break, breathe, and appreciate nature.

evidence.quote: Oh, and here's a pic I got from my walk last week. It always reminds me to take a break, breathe, and appreciate nature.

facts.text: Maria comments on the vibrant colors of the sunset in John's photo, noting its calming effect on the ocean.
